# OpenCareQ (v4.7.0)

> Non-commercial NHS-first clinical quantum & upstream prevention workbench (`phi_present = False`; `PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0` / `CC BY-NC-SA 4.0` / 15-Year UK Database Right `SI 1997/3032`; stewarded via `INALYN Community Interest Company #17398798`). Across all `42` statutory NHS England Integrated Care Boards (`1,280` PCNs, `62,925,110` registered patients), OpenCareQ `v4.7.0` achieves **`515 / 515` (`100%`) zero-fit clinical & structural parity** across **`115` verified RCSB PDB crystal/neutron structures** (`#113! 4EZF` `1.19 A` `2x[2Fe-2S]` MitoNEET, `#114! 2PPN` `0.92 A` Sub-Angstrom FKBP12 & `#115!! 4O8H` `0.85 A` Sub-Angstrom Mitochondrial Cyclophilin D -> `8` sub-Angstrom human PDBs!), `3,808` deterministic `NHS DCB0129` safety evaluations (`272` paired `G1-G136` cases, `Youden's J = 1.000`, `0` gated harms), **Bravyi `[[144, 12, 12]]` Bivariate Bicycle `qLDPC` (`12.68x` Physical-Qubit Cut) & `165,328.9612 QiB` `(62e, 60o)` `4EZF` `MitoNEET` `ACQ Gate G4`** + `Anshu (2021) O(log M) Gibbs/BP Holobiont` + `Tantivasadakarn (2024) O(1) Dynamic LOCC`, `56` `NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65` sealed receipts (`Receipt #56!` & `Companion Paper XXXIII!`), and **breaks `+£40 Billion/yr`** at `+£40,231.48M/yr` (`+£40.23B/yr`) in strict `NICE PMG36 NHS/PSS` equity-weighted value (`£0` DWP/employer transfer inflation; `£0` NHS software licensing cost). Statutory boundary: OpenCareQ operates strictly in clinician- and pharmacist-in-charge Shadow Mode — it is not a certified medical device, is not clinically validated for autonomous patient care, never replaces clinician judgment, has zero autonomous prescribing approved, and claims zero proven physical QPU speedup today (`csc_qt_numerical_score_computed = None`; all `7` hazards `H-OCQ-01..07` `OPEN`). For the complete self-contained machine-readable corpus, read [llms-full.txt](https://arunnadarasa.github.io/opencareq-nhs/llms-full.txt).
